title: GET /rooms/{id} detail endpoint
description: Add GET /rooms/{id} returning room detail: room_id, game_name, max_players, seats (list with seat_name, player_name, connected, ready status), room_phase (waiting/all_ready/in_progress/finished), created_at. 404 if room not found. Used by web lobby to show room state before joining and to render the waiting room.
